name: br.com.signdocs/mcp-server
description: Assinatura eletrônica no Brasil (ICP-Brasil): envie, assine e verifique com sua conta SignDocs.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNDOCS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client ID from app.signdocs.com.br → API

environmentVariables.name: SIGNDOCS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client secret from app.signdocs.com.br → API

headers.name: X-SignDocs-Client-Id
headers.description: Optional. API client ID, for business (pessoa juridica) customers. Leave unset to sign in with your SignDocs account over OAuth.

headers.name: X-SignDocs-Client-Secret
headers.description: Optional. API client secret, paired with X-SignDocs-Client-Id. Not needed when signing in with your SignDocs account.
